description: Override one control's derived obligation basis (write — ADMIN role): mcr or dsr with a reason, or null to clear and derive it from its frameworks again. 404 if the control has no scope record.

basis.description: 'mcr' or 'dsr' to override; null clears the override (and its reason) so the basis is derived from the org's classified frameworks again

reason.description: Why the derived basis is wrong for this control (max 2000 characters) — required when basis is set

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_set_control_basis_override
